definitions.explanation: The line or ridge where two pieces of fabric are sewn together, or the visible line of stitches.

examples.japanese: {縫|ぬ}い{目|め}がほどけてきた。
examples.english: The seam has started to come undone.

examples.japanese: この{服|ふく}は{縫|ぬ}い{目|め}が{丁寧|ていねい}だ。
{縫|ぬ}い{目|め}に{沿|そ}って{切|き}ってください。

notes:
RELATED SEWING TERMS:
・{縫|ぬ}う (to sew)
・{糸|いと} (thread)
・{針|はり} (needle)
・{裏地|うらじ} (lining)
・ミシン (sewing machine)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{縫|ぬ}い{目|め}がほどける (seam comes undone)
・{縫|ぬ}い{目|め}を{直|なお}す (to fix a seam)
・{縫|ぬ}い{目|め}が{目立|めだ}つ (seam is visible/stands out)
・{縫|ぬ}い{目|め}を{隠|かく}す (to hide the seam)

TYPES OF SEAMS:
・{並|なみ}{縫|ぬ}い (running stitch)
・{返|かえ}し{縫|ぬ}い (backstitch)
・{千鳥|ちどり}がけ (herringbone stitch/catch stitch)
